content: We need to find template that when applied to the given molecule reproduces the HWE reaction (retro). The previous step 'make_5_lvl2-apply_template-1' gave precursors list (three possible). Those are likely the result of applying a template. We need to return the mapped_rxn associated with that template and its template_id (integer). So we need to find which template was used to generate those precursors. We can search template catalog by criteria: functional groups broken: C-P bond broken, C-O bond broken? In HWE forward: carbonyl + phosphonate -> alkene + phosphate. In retrosynthesis, we break C-C double bond formed, and form C-P and C-O? Actually forward: C-P bond broken, C-O bond broken, C-C double bond formed. In retrosynthesis, we need to break C-C double bond and form C-P and C-O. So functional_groups_broken (forward) = C-C double bond? The search expects forward reaction criteria: functional_groups_broken are groups broken in forward reaction. So we want templates where forward breaks C-C double bond and forms C-P and C-O (or aliphatic carboxylic acid?). The description says formed groups: aliphatic carboxylic acid and C-C double bonds. Wait description: "As a result, an 'aliphatic carboxylic acid', and  'C-C double bonds' groups are formed." That's forward reaction: product has carboxylic acid and alkene. So broken groups: carbon-phosphorus bond and carbon-oxygen bond. So we should search with functional_groups_broken = ["C-P", "C-O"] and functional_groups_formed = ["aliphatic carboxylic acid", "C-C double bond"] maybe. Let's try.
